comment: NOT the config Vercel reads. Vercel reads vercel.json from the project's Root Directory, so apps/admin/vercel.json serves the office project and apps/field/vercel.json the crew one. This file only applies if someone points a project at the repository root, which nothing should: it would build the office app under whatever name that project has. Two apps, two Vercel projects, Root Directory apps/admin and apps/field.
